name: Curing the Sick

guaranteedRewards.name: Veildust Medicine Bag
tooltip: Use: Restores 50 mana every 3 sec for 15 sec. (30 Min Cooldown)

narrative.details:
I was able to make enough salve for ten doses of curing, adventurer.  While I work with local authorities to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around the northern Barrens are sickly gazelles; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend our thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!
narrative.objectives: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them.  Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have done well in tending to the sickly gazelles of the Barrens; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land. You friend are most eager to understand the ways of Cenarius; you, like your elders in Thunder Bluff, are proving that the need for balance transcends artificial racial barriers.

adventurer, you've proven your worth as an friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you completed what was asked of you by Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads? Your work is not complete unless it is.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 14, 3,325 XP in all.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: The Principal Source
quests.objectiveText: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak. Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads

quests.name: Gathering the Cure
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.

quests.name: Curing the Sick
quests.objectiveText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them.

quests.name: Power over Poison
quests.objectiveText: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.
